name: data_audit_workflow
objective: Detect and report data quality issues without altering source data.

checks.name: missing
checks.method: Apply field-specific nullable and missing rules; never impute automatically.

checks.name: stale
checks.method: Compare ticker/dataset latest date with approved global/reference latest date.

checks.name: duplicate
checks.method: Check declared primary/logical keys; preserve records and report duplicates.

checks.name: minus_one_sentinel
checks.method: Map -1 only in documented fields to queried_no_value/missing.

checks.name: null_context
checks.method: Interpret NULL by schema missing_rule, including margin no-flag convention.

checks.name: date_period_validity
checks.method: Parse YYYY-MM-DD and supported financial periods; match period_type.

checks.name: adjusted_price_uncertainty
checks.method: Flag return/MA/drawdown/backtest outputs if adjustment is unconfirmed.

checks.name: bctc_mapping_gaps
checks.method: Report unconfirmed EBIT, EBITDA, interest, retained earnings, depreciation and SGA mappings.

checks.name: point_in_time_risk
checks.method: Reject current metadata/shareholder/latest snapshots from backtest and enforce cutoff.

limitations: No audit is executed in Phase 4; corporate-action and publication-date sources are not fully confirmed.
